-- ----------------------------
-- Inbound answered connections
-- ----------------------------
WITH inbound_connections AS (
	-- ------
	-- Source
	-- ------
	SELECT
		c.source_participant_id AS participant_id,
    min(c.cdr_started_at) AS started_at,
		sum(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_started_at, c.cdr_ended_at)) AS duration,
		sum(CASE WHEN c.destination_entity_type NOT IN ('group', 'ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt', 'queue') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_answered_at, c.cdr_ended_at) ELSE 0 END) AS talking_duration,
		0.00 AS bill_cost
	FROM public_cdroutput AS c
	-- LEFT JOIN public_cdrbilling AS b ON
	-- 	b.cdr_id = c.cdr_id
	WHERE $__timeFilter(c.cdr_started_at)
	AND c.source_entity_type = 'external_line'
	AND c.source_participant_is_incoming
	AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
	GROUP BY c.source_participant_id
	UNION ALL
	-- -----------
	-- Destination
	-- -----------
	SELECT
		c.destination_participant_id AS participant_id,
    min(c.cdr_started_at) AS started_at,
		sum(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_started_at, c.cdr_ended_at)) AS duration,
		sum(coalesce(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_answered_at, c.cdr_ended_at), 0)) AS talking_duration,
		0.00 AS bill_cost
	FROM public_cdroutput AS c
	-- LEFT JOIN public_cdrbilling AS b ON
	-- 	b.cdr_id = c.cdr_id
	WHERE $__timeFilter(c.cdr_started_at)
	AND c.destination_entity_type = 'external_line'
	AND c.destination_participant_is_incoming
	AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
	GROUP BY participant_id
),
-- -----------------------------
-- Outbound answered connections
-- -----------------------------
outbound_connections AS (
  -- -----------
  -- Destination
  -- -----------
  SELECT
    c.destination_participant_id AS participant_id,
		min(c.cdr_started_at) AS started_at,
		TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, min(c.cdr_started_at), max(c.cdr_ended_at)) AS duration,
		sum(coalesce(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_answered_at, c.cdr_ended_at), 0)) AS talking_duration,
    sum(
			round(coalesce(CAST(b.destination_bill_rate AS DECIMAL(63, 2)), 0.00) * coalesce((TIME_TO_SEC(b.destination_bill_duration) * 1000000 + MICROSECOND(b.destination_bill_duration)) / 60000000, 0.00), 2)
    ) AS bill_cost
  FROM public_cdroutput AS c
  LEFT JOIN public_cdrbilling AS b ON
    b.cdr_id = c.cdr_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.cdr_started_at)
  AND c.destination_entity_type = 'external_line'
  AND c.destination_participant_is_incoming = FALSE
  AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.destination_participant_id
  UNION ALL
  -- ------
  -- Source
  -- ------
  SELECT
    c.source_participant_id AS participant_id,
		min(c.cdr_started_at) AS started_at,
		TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, min(c.cdr_started_at), max(c.cdr_ended_at)) AS duration,
		sum(CASE WHEN c.destination_entity_type NOT IN ('group', 'ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt', 'queue') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_answered_at, c.cdr_ended_at) ELSE 0 END) AS talking_duration,
    sum(
			round(coalesce(CAST(b.source_bill_rate AS DECIMAL(63, 2)), 0.00) * coalesce((TIME_TO_SEC(b.source_bill_duration) * 1000000 + MICROSECOND(b.source_bill_duration)) / 60000000, 0.00), 2)
    ) AS bill_cost
  FROM public_cdroutput AS c
  LEFT JOIN public_cdrbilling AS b ON
    b.cdr_id = c.cdr_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.cdr_started_at)
  AND c.source_entity_type = 'external_line'
  AND c.source_participant_is_incoming = FALSE
  AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.source_participant_id
),
-- Inbound statistics
inbound_stat AS (
	SELECT
		0 AS direction_id,
		'in' AS direction,
		STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(i.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time_bucket,
		count(DISTINCT i.participant_id) AS connections_count,
		sum(i.duration) AS duration,
		sum(i.talking_duration) AS talking_duration,
		sum(i.bill_cost) AS bill_cost
	FROM inbound_connections AS i
	GROUP BY time_bucket
),
-- Outbound statistics
outbound_stat AS (
	SELECT
		1 AS direction_id,
		'out' AS direction,
		STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(o.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time_bucket,
		count(DISTINCT o.participant_id) AS connections_count,
		sum(o.duration) AS duration,
		sum(o.talking_duration) AS talking_duration,
		sum(o.bill_cost) AS bill_cost
	FROM outbound_connections AS o
	GROUP BY time_bucket
)
-- ---------------------------------------------
-- FULL JOIN incoming_calls workaround for MySQL
-- 1. inbound_stat -> outbound_stat (LEFT JOIN)
SELECT
    COALESCE(i.time_bucket, o.time_bucket) AS time_bucket,
    COALESCE(i.connections_count, 0) + COALESCE(o.connections_count, 0) AS connections_count,
    COALESCE(i.connections_count, 0) AS inbound_connections_count,
    COALESCE(i.duration, 0) AS inbound_duration,
    COALESCE(i.talking_duration, 0) AS inbound_talking_duration,
    COALESCE(i.bill_cost, 0.00) AS inbound_bill_cost,
    COALESCE(o.connections_count, 0) AS outbound_connections_count,
    COALESCE(o.duration, 0) AS outbound_duration,
    COALESCE(o.talking_duration, 0) AS outbound_talking_duration,
    COALESCE(o.bill_cost, 0.00) AS outbound_bill_cost
FROM inbound_stat AS i
LEFT JOIN outbound_stat AS o ON
	o.time_bucket = i.time_bucket
UNION
-- 2. outbound_stat -> inbound_stat (RIGHT JOIN equivalent with filter)
SELECT
    COALESCE(i.time_bucket, o.time_bucket) AS time_bucket,
    COALESCE(i.connections_count, 0) + COALESCE(o.connections_count, 0) AS connections_count,
    COALESCE(i.connections_count, 0) AS inbound_connections_count,
    COALESCE(i.duration, 0) AS inbound_duration,
    COALESCE(i.talking_duration, 0) AS inbound_talking_duration,
    COALESCE(i.bill_cost, 0.00) AS inbound_bill_cost,
    COALESCE(o.connections_count, 0) AS outbound_connections_count,
    COALESCE(o.duration, 0) AS outbound_duration,
    COALESCE(o.talking_duration, 0) AS outbound_talking_duration,
    COALESCE(o.bill_cost, 0.00) AS outbound_bill_cost
FROM outbound_stat AS o
LEFT JOIN inbound_stat AS i ON
	i.time_bucket = o.time_bucket
WHERE i.time_bucket IS NULL
ORDER BY time_bucket -- coalesce(i.time_bucket, o.time_bucket)
;

	SELECT
		0 AS direction_id,
		'in' AS direction,
		min(i.started_at) AS started_at,

		sum(i.bill_cost) AS bill_cost
	FROM inbound_connections AS i
